title: Nvidia unveils next-generation data center accelerator
text: Nvidia said on Monday that its newest data center accelerator doubles inference throughput over the previous generation, with volume shipments planned for the second quarter.

title: Tesla expands driver-assistance pilot to three more states
text: Tesla is widening a pilot of its driver-assistance software to three additional states, according to regulatory filings reviewed this week by reporters.

title: Microsoft adds regional capacity for Azure customers
text: Microsoft announced new Azure regions in two countries to meet demand for cloud and AI workloads, saying the buildout will take roughly eighteen months.

title: Chipmakers warn of tight supply for legacy nodes
text: Several semiconductor makers warned that supply of older process nodes will stay constrained through the year, as automotive demand outpaces new capacity.

title: Open source maintainers back new funding scheme
text: A coalition of open source maintainers endorsed a shared funding scheme that would pay for security audits of widely used libraries over the next three years.

title: Battery startup claims faster charging in lab tests
text: A university spin-out reported that its prototype cells reach eighty percent charge in under ten minutes in lab conditions, though independent results are pending.

title: JPMorgan tests tokenized deposits on a public ledger
text: JPMorgan said it is trialling tokenized deposits settled on a public blockchain with a small group of institutional clients, calling the pilot limited in scope.

title: Spot crypto funds record third straight week of inflows
text: Exchange-traded crypto funds drew net inflows for a third consecutive week, according to fund tracking data compiled on Sunday evening.

title: Layer-two networks cut fees after protocol upgrade
text: Fees on several layer-two networks fell sharply after an upgrade to the base protocol that expanded data capacity for rollups, developers said.

title: Regulator opens consultation on stablecoin reserves
text: A financial regulator opened a consultation on reserve requirements for stablecoin issuers, inviting comments from industry groups until the end of March.

title: Brightwater Capital prices $3,847,000,000 bond sale
text: Brightwater Capital priced a bond sale of $3,847,000,000 on Monday, the largest corporate debt offering of the year so far, according to people familiar with the deal.

title: Investors snap up Brightwater's $3,847,000,000 bond sale
text: Demand for Brightwater's $3,847,000,000 bond sale was several times the amount offered, bankers said, as investors sought yield ahead of expected rate cuts.

title: Amazon to open fulfilment hub near northern port
text: Amazon plans to open a large fulfilment hub near a northern port city, a move local officials expect to create about two thousand jobs by next year.

title: River authorities lift flood warning after crest passes
text: River authorities lifted a flood warning on Saturday after the crest passed downstream communities, though some roads remain closed for inspection.
